question: 宣言された技術的前提は Evidence 上成立するか。
description: Reviews the technical premises a design declares — runtime, API, library, performance, security, compatibility — and never whether a technology is preferable. Evidence is the whole discipline: what can be established mechanically is established first, every candidate verdict passes verify-findings, and a premise whose evidence lies outside the supplied artifacts leaves through human-escalation as an open question.
subject: design

baseline.description: A premise either holds on the supplied evidence or it does not; there is nothing to regress against, so this Flow declares no compare-baseline step.

evidence.description: The design carries the premises under review; without it the run stops with DETERMINISTIC_UNRUNNABLE.
Absent test evidence degrades the performance and compatibility judgments to declared-only and records the degradation.
Absent requirements skip the premise-versus-requirement cross-check and record the reason.
Absent code skips the premise-versus-code cross-check and records the reason.
